# Pizza Pie

Pizza Pie is an officially named *My Little Pony* April Fools’ promotional gag: supposedly Pinkie Pie’s sister and the bearer of the “Element of Appetite.” She is a separate character in that joke, not a Pinkie Pie disguise. Her pale-yellow Earth-pony design has an orange mane and tail, green eyes, and a pizza-slice cutie mark, resembling Golden Harvest. [Character index](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Mentioned_ponies).

[![Pizza Pie promotional artwork](https://derpicdn.net/img/view/2017/4/1/1401338.jpg)](https://www.neogaf.com/threads/my-little-pony-friendship-is-magic-season-6-ot-six-seasons-and-a-movie.1200896/page-21)

*Image: My Little Pony’s 2017 social-media promotion, reproduced in a contemporary fan discussion; individual illustrator unverified.*

*Name and continuity:* “Pizza Pie” came from official My Little Pony Facebook accounts, not a fan naming campaign. The original post explicitly said `#AprilFools`; a later Spanish-language post repeated the character without that disclaimer. This makes her an officially promoted joke character, not an established member of the television continuity.

*Speaking and appearances:* No verified onscreen appearance, spoken line, voice actor, or film/comic role. In *The Cutie Mark Chronicles* (S1E23), Pinkie talks about her sisters, but Pizza Pie is neither named nor shown. Pinkie’s pizza costume in *Rock Solid Friendship* (S7E4) should not be mistaken for Pizza Pie.

## Important moments

- *1 April 2017 — April Fools introduction (social post, no episode):* My Little Pony introduced Pizza Pie as Pinkie’s sister and jokingly assigned her the Element of Appetite.
- *11 July 2017 — Spanish-language return (social post, no episode):* Another official account repeated her name and supposed powers without an April Fools label. [Pie family sources](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Pie_family).

Neither event is an episode scene; a full-episode video timestamp is therefore unavailable. No character-defining television scenes could be verified.
